She scoffed and said the same back to me. I told her that her attitude was going to get her in trouble in the real world and she said 'think I'll be just fine, but thanks for the advice.' AITA? I don't know why she hates me so much and is so goddamn controlling.

It’s called **"enclothed cognition,"** which means the clothes we wear can influence our thoughts, emotions, and even behavior. It’s like your outfit acts as a mental "switch" that helps you step into a confident mindset, especially in professional or high-stakes situations.

Some people feel most like themselves in casual wear, while others thrive in formal dress—it’s deeply personal. What matters most is how *you* feel in what you’re wearing.
